content: Timing-requirements of SW-Components Type: valid Description: The SW-Component template must allow specifying the timing-requirements of each runnable entity of a SW-Component (e.g.): • Period • Reaction time Rationale: The SW-Component template must allow describing: • how often it has to be run • the time between a stimulus like e.g. the state change of a hardware or software entity and the expected reaction of the system (e.g. response, actuator activation) 5 19 of 34  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 410: AUTOSAR_RS_TimingExtensions Requirements on Timing Extensions AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Use Case: None Dependencies: [RS_TIMEX_00013] Supporting Material: None
